messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary healthcheck alert for deployment wave-3 in model-serving-prod. 5xx rate 4.7% over 2m (threshold 1.0%). alert_id=ALRT-1766660000
priya: I'm on it — paging ops and looking at grafana now.
alex: which region is the spike?
priya: eu-west-1 primarily, small tail in us-east. wave-3 was at 10% traffic, rolled 2m ago.
emily: seeing repeated `kvcache-invalidate` errors and a pair of OOMs on quantized-kernel workers. stack traces look like mem growth after token 1024.
priya: ok let's stop the rollout before it gets worse. alex can you flip the kill-switch `feature.rollout.wave3` off?
alex: running `./flagctl set feature.rollout.wave3 false` -> done :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Rollout stopped. new traffic to wave-3 now 0%. initiating automatic rollback to wave-2.
priya: kicking manual rollback as well: `/deploy rollback wave-3 --force`
deploy-bot: Rollback started (wave-3 -> wave-2), estimated 90s to drain.
emily: quick customer impact check: 0.34% of requests returned 5xx in last 5m. top affected tenants: corp-acct-42, beta-pool. CS alerted.
alex: created incident INF-2987 so we have a canonical place: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-2987 — tagging @oncall-sre and @platform-team.
oncall-bot: @priya you are current on-call. Paging SRE rotation message sent. Next handoff in ~3h.
priya: will hand off to alex after rollback completes. I'll summarize & post notes.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. wave-3 instances drained and traffic shifted back to wave-2.
emily: metrics: eu-west 5xx back to baseline in ~30s post-rollback, now ~0.05%. p50/p95 latencies normalizing.
priya: good. provisional cause: memory leak/regression in quantized kernel for model v2 during long-context runs -> leads to OOM and kvcache errors. reverting to model v1 prevented the failure. assigning postmortem to emily.
emily: will aggregate traces, kcov logs, and kernel build info into INF-2987. proposal: add healthcheck cooldown and stricter abort gating for quantized kernels.
alex: I'll add a quick mitigation playbook entry and a circuit-breaker flag for future waves. also will add a canary-size guard for kernel-level deploys.
priya: thanks. I'll prepare a customer-impact blurb for CS and schedule the postmortem. handing off monitoring to @kai for 1h lookback.
kai: taking over monitoring. will run 1h lookbacks and keep pager open. ping me if anything drifts.
priya: handoff summary for kai and SRE: Canary wave-3 triggered elevated 5xx due to kvcache/oom on quantized kernel in eu-west. Stoppped rollout via feature flag, executed rollback, metrics recovered. See INF-2987 for logs and next steps.
alex: adding follow-up tasks: add unit test coverage for long-context allocation, add gating for model kernel rollouts.
emily: noting potential release blocker for next deploy until kernel fix verified.
priya: closing thread here after handoff. great work everyone. :thumbsup:
